answerHead:
BioMate

Antibody Antigen Complex — Co-folds an antibody and antigen structure together to predict binding interfaces and validate scFv design.

Input: Demo antibody–antigen pair (FMC63 scFv × CD19 fragment); parameters only — your attached PDB and FASTA files are not used by this workflow
Key steps:
Boltz-1 co-folding → predicted complex structure with confidence scores (pLDDT, PAE)
Interface analysis → contact residues, buried surface area, binding geometry
Expected output: Complex PDB file + interface metrics JSON + confidence visualization

To design scFv sequences from your 6Z43 nanobody–spike complex with CDR constraints and b12 framework grafting, you will need a different workflow: scfv_antibody_design or antibody_developability, which read PDB structure input and preserve your CDR/framework specifications.

Would you like me to generate one of those workflows instead? I can bind them to your 6Z43.pdb structure and apply the constraints from your nanobody_constraints.json.
